intro.heading: A focused manufacturing partner for industrial components
intro.text:
Jugnu Roshni Pvt. Ltd. was established in 2023 in the Rajinder Nagar Industrial Area, Ghaziabad. We manufacture and supply turned components for switchgear, lighting, energy meter and automobile industries, along with sheet metal components, press tools, elevator components and accessories. We also undertake job work and industrial fabrication for customers across India.

Every component is produced from quality raw material sourced from established vendors and checked against defined parameters before dispatch.

faq.q: What products does Jugnu Roshni Pvt. Ltd. (JURO) manufacture?
faq.a: We manufacture turned components for the switchgear, lighting, energy meter and automobile industries, sheet metal components, press tools, and elevator components and accessories. We also provide industrial fabrication and job work.

faq.q: Can you make components to our own drawing?
faq.a: Yes. Our components are customised to the technical specifications shared by customers. Send us your drawing or a sample along with the quantity required.
Yes. We take up machining, pressing and fabrication job work, including MIG welding, arc welding and gas cutting.
Our works is at Plot No. 28–29, Between Gali No. 3 & 4, Rajinder Nagar Industrial Area, Mohan Nagar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201005. Our head office is in Sector 16B, Greater Noida.

Our shop floor has Traub machines, drilling machines, power presses (5, 10 and 20 ton), a lathe, vertical milling machine, surface grinder, tapping machine, band saw, MIG and arc welding machines and a gas cutting machine, with a 15 kVA generator for power backup.

faq.q: How can I get a quotation?
faq.a: Fill in the enquiry form on the Contact page, message us on WhatsApp, or call +91 90455 06413 / +91 99908 22343 with your component details and quantity.
